description: 禁止通过编辑 Evidence 内容改变 provenance 层级

rules.name: Layer Immutability
rules.description: Evidence 创建后，provenance_layer 不可修改

rules.name: Authority Consistency
rules.description: authority_status 必须与 provenance_layer 匹配

rules.name: Source Traceability
rules.description: DIRECT fidelity 必须有可追溯的 source_locator 和 edition

rules.name: No Provenance Upgrade
rules.description: 禁止 B→A, C→A, C→B 等 provenance 升级操作

validation_checks: A层必须有 edition 字段
